facts.value: Supply, distribution, and network maintenance of potable water and wastewater/sewage services for Bekaa and Baalbek-Hermel governorates. Established under Law 221 dated 1/5/2000. One of four Lebanese water establishments under Ministry of Energy and Water supervision.
facts.notes: Wastewater scope inferred from Law 221/2000 which mandates same scope for all 4 water establishments. Confirmed operational as of June 2026 from Facebook procurement post.

facts.value: NOT responsible for private building plumbing, internal water pipes, rooftop tanks, or building pumps. Responsible only for the public water supply and sewage network up to the building connection point.

Covers Bekaa governorate and Baalbek-Hermel governorate — all districts: Zahle, West Bekaa, Rashaya, Baalbek, Hermel. Does NOT cover Beirut/Mount Lebanon (→ BMLWE), North Lebanon/Akkar (→ NLWE), or South Lebanon/Nabatiyeh (→ SLWE). Note: Zahle city electricity is served by EDZ (private concession), not EDL — but water is served by BWE.

Website: bwe.gov.lb (temporarily unavailable as of June 2026 — use Facebook page as alternative). Facebook: facebook.com/BekaaWaterEst (active, 5.8K followers). Complaints hotline: 1781 (from any landline — confirmed from official BWE Facebook featured post June 2024). HQ address: Zahle Highway, Abed Deyem Building, Floors 3 and 4. (2) Call branch directly by GPS location: Zahle 08/820236, Baalbek 08/370335, Stations 08/811389, South Bekaa 08/663414. (3) Email info@bwe.gov.lb. No online complaint form confirmed (website unavailable). Facebook page (facebook.com/BekaaWaterEst) is active and can be used for non-urgent contact. For CedarFix: route by GPS → identify district → direct to 1781 or nearest branch number.
facts.notes: Medium confidence because website is temporarily unavailable — online form existence not confirmed. 1781 hotline is confirmed from Facebook.

facts.value: Water supply interruption classification (same framework as all 4 Lebanese water establishments under Law 221/2000): (A) UNPLANNED cut — no prior notice — sudden network fault, contamination, emergency maintenance, force majeure → valid infrastructure complaint → route to BWE via 1781. (B) PLANNED cut — with prior notice — network extensions, upgrades, maintenance, efficiency programs → planned outage, inform citizen, do NOT route as complaint. (C) ADMINISTRATIVE cut — with warning — subscriber failed to pay bills within deadline → billing issue, NOT infrastructure complaint → direct to billing/payment at branch.
facts.notes: Applied from SLWE FAQ (confirmed) and Law 221/2000 framework shared by all 4 water establishments. Critical for CedarFix to disambiguate 'no water' complaints before routing.

facts.value: No officially published SLA. CedarFix targets: supply interruption 24-48h; pipe burst 24h; contamination — immediate HITL escalation; sewage overflow — immediate HITL escalation.

primary_for_sectors: WATER_supply — no water, supply interruption, low pressure (Bekaa + Baalbek-Hermel)
WATER_pipe — burst pipe, water leak from public network
WATER_contamination — unsafe, discolored, or smelly water
WASTEWATER_overflow — sewage overflow, blocked public sewer
WATER_connection — new connection, illegal connection report
not_responsible_for: Private building plumbing or internal pipes — private contractor
Rooftop tanks or building pumps — private responsibility
Water issues in Beirut or Mount Lebanon — route to BMLWE
Water issues in North Lebanon or Akkar — route to NLWE
Water issues in South Lebanon or Nabatiyeh — route to SLWE
Zahle city electricity — route to EDZ not EDL (water is still BWE)
hitl_conditions: Water contamination reports — always HITL, potential public health emergency
Sewage overflow into streets or public spaces — HITL, public health risk
Complaint is ambiguous between unplanned outage and billing disconnection — HITL to clarify
